name: Steamed cassava
summary: Steamed cassava, fragrant and lightly sweet, with pandan or coconut cream. One account mixes both and calls the root chewy and rich.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động, crediting Ngôi sao, on 6 Mar 2017, and Báo Quốc tế on 11 Aug 2024, both tie steamed cassava to the tunnels and to the wartime years. Tuổi Trẻ, on 5 May 2024, names it at chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều.
howToEat: One account steams it with pandan, or with coconut cream, and also grinds the root for bánh tằm. Another steams it with pandan and sesame salt and mixes in coconut cream.
It is sold along the roads toward Củ Chi, cooked for people at the tunnels, and named at chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Along the roads toward Củ Chi, at the tunnels, and at chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều.
seoDescription: Steamed Cu Chi cassava, fragrant and lightly sweet, with pandan or coconut cream.
taste: The steamed root is fragrant and lightly sweet. With coconut cream it is chewy and rich.
